title_ladders router (backend/api/title_ladders.py): one GET, /api/v1/players/{steam_id}/title-ladders. It reads players (one row by steam_id, of which only id and active_title_id are used; the row is never serialized), player_items joined to shop_items (sku), shop_items (sku, id) and title_ladder_progress (line, games, tier), and answers a fixed projection built from those values and the in-module LADDERS catalogue. Its first statement is SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY (one snapshot per request), and each rung's owned also asks main._auto_owned(steam_id, sku), a set test on the path parameter that sends no query. It reads no matches table and no Match ORM row, so no W1 seat column can reach its output. Static classification: handler-implementation drift (a Match read, or serializing the Player row) would need re-review. Enumerated only under the pinned fastapi==0.115.0 (0.141 wraps included routers as _IncludedRouter, invisible to app.routes) - the test asserts the pin.

verified-reads control routes (backend/api/main.py): GET /api/v1/read-gate/probe answers a fixed body once the read gate admits it; the other five require an admin signature: the operator-key routes (list, issue, revoke) and the read-gate mode route respond from api_operator_keys and runtime_settings, the read-census route from the in-process census. No route here reads matches, so no W1 private Match column can reach its output.

auto-log router (backend/api/auto_logs.py): the upload route responds from its own write -- a status word, the new bug_reports row's id and bug_number, the stored blob size and the write-time scrub's counters -- and the internal prune route responds with its own sweep's tallies. Neither reads the matches table at all, so no W1 private Match column has a path to either output. Static classification: handler-implementation drift is caught by the source fingerprint beside each row.

match hold router (backend/api/match_hold.py, mounted by main.py include_router): the ten Stage 2 readmission routes under /api/v1/match (game/start, hold/open, hold/beat, hold/{hold_id}/end, claim, bind, entered, hold/{hold_id}/state, hold/by-room, hold/mine). Every handler requires a verified session (steam_sessions, players) and reads team_series or ovt_series by an explicit column list, match_games, match_seat_holds, match_seat_presence, match_hold_open_attempts, match_hold_attempts, queue_leases and the four queue tables; hold/{hold_id}/entered also finishes its room's held reports (match_report_journal, match_report_windows and the settle bodies). Every answer is a fixed projection (_state_payload's named fields or a literal dict); no handler reads the matches table or a Match ORM row, so no W1 private Match column can reach an output.
